name: opencode-pty-pinned
description: Local pinned install of opencode-pty. Upstream 0.3.4 declares bun-pty ^0.4.8, which resolves to 0.4.9, but the plugin's monkey-patch guard (manager.js) throws on anything > 0.4.8. Pin bun-pty to 0.4.8 so the plugin loads. Remove once upstream issue #36 is fixed. https://github.com/shekohex/opencode-pty/issues/36
